thesis: CleanSpark is a U.S.-listed bitcoin miner that owns power-backed data center sites, operates roughly **1,027 megawatts** of infrastructure, and runs **336,544** ASIC miners (**241,934** in service at September 30, 2025). **[Fact]** FY2025 digital currency mining revenue was **$766.3 million** (+102% versus **$379.0 million** in FY2024). **[Fact]** Average operational hash rate was **45.6 exahash per second** (**4.3%** of global network hash). **[Fact]** FY2025 operating cash flow was **$461.0 million** and capital spending on productive assets was **$144.7 million**. **[Fact]** The company sells the majority of mined bitcoin for working capital but began retaining treasury balances and running a Digital Asset Management (Spot+) covered-call program in April 2025. **[Fact]** In October 2025 management added an AI data center leader and signed a non-binding framework with Submer for modular AI cooling while acquiring **271 acres** in Texas with **285 megawatts** of contracted power for future high-performance computing.
why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** complexity discount (GAAP earnings dominated by bitcoin fair-value marks, convertibles, and an unproven AI hosting pivot).
